summary: Phase 6 i18n (FEAT-001/002/003) is complete and correct against plan.md Groups 0 and A-I and the remaining-strings audit. FEAT-001: every new AppStrings key exists in abstract + EnStrings + HeStrings with English byte-identical to the old literals (verified clockSpoken reproduces ClockTime.spoken for minutes 0/15/30/45 + numeric fallback; nqTipDefault/Body/etc. match) and Hebrew per the strings doc; the ss.shape.label catalog domain is present with all 8 ShapeKind.name keys. FEAT-002: all six game-screen headers localize boss/guardian names via *.guardian.name/*.boss.name catalog lookups and numbered stops via stopN/levelN/lessonN (no raw English title/guardian/boss leaking); the NQ skill tag localizes via nq.skill.label for all worlds (isCampaign gate removed); Clock and Shape generators thread AppLang through forLevel, branch prompts + spoken-time/shape-names on he, and keep the English path byte-identical (regression-tested); clock setter captions (clockHour/clockMinute) localize via screen-resolved _lang. StatChip is shared (matches CoinPill styling) and routed into both the hub _ProfileBar and NQ _Hud streak chips; the NQ-only XpBar is removed from the home HUD with its import dropped (grep confirms no XpBar references in number_quest). Tests: word_wizard_speaker_test.dart renamed to word_wizard_hebrew_test.dart and trimmed of speaker assertions; new clock_hero_hebrew_generator_test, shape_safari_hebrew_generator_test, game_header_hebrew_test, and sound_toggle_hebrew_test all present with Hebrew-presence + English-regression + no-leak assertions. Recorded FEAT verification (status completed, findings) is accurate: I re-ran verification and build web printed 'Built build\web' and flutter test reported 'All tests passed!' at +97 (89 baseline - 1 deleted speaker test + 9 new = 97). No blocking issues.
